caption: [character1], a master chef, with black hair tied in a sleek bun and wearing a pristine white double-breasted chef's coat with gold trim, and [character2], a skilled sous-chef, with short silver-cropped hair and a black leather apron over a grey silk tunic, exchanging rapid martial arts strikes with kitchen utensils, positioned in the center of the workspace while facing forward, a high-end restaurant kitchen with polished steel and hanging copper pans under high noon sun and a light drizzle, rapid 360-degree orbital tracking, medium-wide framing, perspective, shallow depth of field, mandatory instruction to keep faces front-facing and visible.
